title: Administrator - IT Operations Management, RESTful API, Angular
Drupal Developer (Frontend Focused)
description:
**Job Overview** 

We are seeking a skilled Drupal Developer with 2 \+ years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate should have expertise in Drupal, HTML, CSS, Twig, and PHP to build and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications.

**What You’ll Do**

* Work extensively with Drupal 9,10 and 11, handling both front\-end and back end development.
* Develop and maintain applications using PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
* Implement Drupal theming, including Twig templating, to customize the look and feel of Drupal sites.
* Apply strong knowledge of Drupal APIs and follow Drupal coding standards and best practices.
* Develop and maintain custom Drupal modules.
* Leverage Drupal’s Content Management System (CMS) to implement custom functionality.
* Work with SQL databases such as MySQL and MariaDB, including Drupal’s Database API.
* Use Git for version control and codebase management.
* Ensure responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility for all developed websites.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Noida)

title: Software Engineer-II (Frontend)
description:
**About Us** \- Attentive.ai is a fast\-growing vertical SaaS start\-up, proudly supported by renowned investors, including Sequoia Surge, InfoEdge Ventures, Vertex Ventures, Tenacity Ventures \& Insight Partner that provides innovative software solutions for the landscape, paving \& construction industries in the United States. Our mission is to help businesses in this space improve their operations and grow their revenue through our simple \& easy\-to\-use software platforms.  

  

**Position Description:** We are looking for a SDE\-II Frontend with excellent design, hands on development \& technical skills along with good interpersonal skills, capable of working in highly critical transformation projects. As a senior front\-end engineer at Attentive, you will help us design, develop and maintain beautiful interfaces and complex client\-side applications of our SaaS product **Roles \& Responsibilities:*** Write effective, scalable, and reusable code
* Develop and maintain user\-facing elements integrated securely with the internal backend
* Participate and contribute to system design and architecture discussions
* Take full ownership of assigned modules and ensure product delivery as per agreed timelines
* Mentor junior team members and perform code reviews
* Conduct frequent brainstorming sessions, and motivate the team, and drive innovations
* Test and debug programs
* Improve functionality of existing systems
* Implement security and data protection solutions
* Assess and prioritize feature requests
* Coordinate with internal teams to understand user requirements and provide technical solutions.

**Required Skills \& Experience:*** In\-depth knowledge of how the internet, websites, and browsers work (working knowledge of server technologies, HTTP protocol, CDN, and caching concepts)
* 3\+ years of software development experience with deep expertise in frontend technologies
* Core UI Development experience with expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Experience with Next.js, React.js, TypeScript and relevant libraries such as React Query, Zustand etc.
* Strong UX sense to provide efficient solutions in the product design process
* Product \& Design Knowledge \- Experience with Product Development and developing functional components
* Understanding of SEO principles
* Understanding of cross\-browser compatibility issues and workable solutions
* Experience with designing responsive interfaces for different screen sizes (mobile, tablet, laptop)
* Team spirit and good problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of cloud services like AWS and GCP
* Experience working with testing frameworks/libraries such as Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working in both start\-up and enterprise environments
* Working knowledge of browser automation technologies like Selenium web driver

**Good to have:*** Understanding of Geographic Information Systems and related terminologies is preferred
* Understanding of front\-end mapping libraries like OpenLayers, Leaflet etc.
* Understanding of webpack config, web page speed and size optimization
* Understanding of Docker build system and deployment configurations.
